manifest.name: @andrepontesmelo/dsh-suite
manifest.description: The DSH productivity suite: plugins + agent skills for the DeepSeek Harness, installable in one command.

bundle.text:
# dsh-suite: one command installs the whole suite.
# `dependencies` pulls the plugin packages; the rows below activate them.
# Suite-level skills ship inside THIS package (skills/, via customSkillDirs).
# Plugin configuration (model-router routes) stays in YOUR profile patch.
- insert:
    # virtual model ids -> routed candidates (add your own routes in your profile)
    - id: model-router
      name: '@andrepontesmelo/dsh-model-router'
    # cold-start project context injected into every new session
    - id: deep-horizon
      name: deep-horizon/dsh
    # register the nine bundled agent skills
    - id: skill-suite
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
      config:
        customSkillDirs:
          # self-referential pattern from the shipped cordis preset:
          # points discovery at THIS package's skills/ directory.
          - !!js "process.getBuiltinModule('node:url').fileURLToPath(new URL('skills/', baseUrl))"

readme.text:
[](https://github.com/andrepontesmelo/dsh-suite/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

Plugins and agent skills for [DSH](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh), installable in one command. After a restart of the harness, the profile has virtual model ids with automatic failover, cold-start project context in every new session, and nine agent skills wired in — routes and credentials stay yours.

| Piece | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [`dsh-model-router`](https://github.com/andrepontesmelo/dsh-model-router) | plugin | Virtual model ids routed over real provider/model candidates — priority failover, round-robin rotation, sleep windows |
| [`deep-horizon`](https://github.com/andrepontesmelo/deep-horizon) | plugin | Injects the project's horizon (open gaps + about line) into every new session — cold-start project context shared across harnesses |
| strong-orchestrator | skill | Sequential implement → review-loop orchestration with a persistent implementer |
| dex / dex-plan | skills | Task hierarchies: epics, subtasks, verification via the dex CLI |
| ponytail (+ audit, debt, gain, help, review) | skills | Lazy-senior-dev output style family: shortest working diff wins |

Standalone siblings that don't ride in this bundle: [archloop](https://github.com/andrepontesmelo/archloop) (overnight architecture-improvement loop driver) and [hkrc](https://github.com/andrepontesmelo/hkrc) (Hermes Kanban blocker recovery controller).

Requires a DSH profile to install into:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:andrepontesmelo/dsh-suite
```

That command installs this package, pulls the plugin dependencies (`@andrepontesmelo/dsh-model-router` and `deep-horizon`), and registers the bundle patch, which points DSH skill discovery at the nine bundled skills. Restart the harness and every suite piece is live in that profile.

Both dependencies are pinned to release tags (`deep-horizon#v0.2.0`, `@andrepontesmelo/dsh-model-router#v0.2.1`), so what an install pulls cannot drift between installs — pin your install the same way (tag) rather than floating on a branch. This bundle registers nine agent skills into the target profile; audit a bundle you did not write before installing it.

It's working if, after a restart:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> list
